name: Moan
description: Each creature within 60 feet of the aberration that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the aberration's next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the aberration's moan for the next 24 hours.
